# HTPN Healthcare Intelligence Office — Digital Health Showcase

## About
This is the official digital showcase of the Healthcare Intelligence Office (HIO) at Hospital Tengku Permaisuri Norashikin (HTPN), Kajang, Selangor, Malaysia — a public hospital under the Ministry of Health Malaysia (KKM).

The HIO team builds homegrown digital health tools created by clinicians and healthcare staff to solve real problems in their own departments — without waiting for top-down IT procurement.

Website: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app
Contact: udppkhtpn@moh.gov.my

---

## Live Projects

### Patient's Journey

**GynaeClerk — Gynae Pre-Consultation**
Mobile-first digital clerking form for gynaecology SOPD. Patients fill 8 structured clinical sections on their own phone via QR code while waiting, handing doctors a complete history before the consult.
Built by: Dr Hamizah, Dr Asma' (O&G Dept)
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/preconsult-gynae

**AntenatalClerk — Obstetric Pre-Consultation**
Mobile-first antenatal clerking form. Patients complete 32 structured steps on their phone via QR code while waiting, giving the doctor a full obstetric history before the consultation begins.
Built by: Dr Koghila, Dr Liyana (O&G Dept)
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/preconsult-obstetric

**Fetal Kick Chart App**
Mobile web tool for admitted expectant mothers to log and monitor daily fetal movements — supporting early detection of fetal distress with real-time staff visibility.
Built by: Matron Norziah, KJ Manimala, KJ Zanariah, KJ Nur Azimah (O&G Dept)
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/fetal-kick-chart

### Doctor's Journey

**OT Scheduling System**
Digital booking system for seamless Operating Theatre slot reservations with live schedule displays — accessible online by all departments for surgical planning.
Built by: Dr Fairis, Dr Nida (Anaesthesiology)
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/ot-scheduling

**Gynae Census Web Form**
Daily digital logging of gynaecological procedures enabling census tracking, annual report generation, and access to credentialing or training logbook records.
Built by: Dr Hazimah, Dr Missdalia, Dr Zulaikha (O&G Dept)
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/gynae-census

**EBL Estimator AI App**
AI-powered clinical tool that calculates Estimated Blood Loss during surgeries and deliveries by analysing uploaded photos — supporting rapid intraoperative decisions.
Built by: Dr Amalyna, Dr Anita bt Ali (O&G Dept)
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/ebl-estimator

**TherapyAI**
AI-powered clinical assistant that automates transcription, structured note generation, and risk stratification for psychological therapy sessions.
Built by: Dr Naim (Psychiatry)
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/therapy-ai

**Skin Diary Generator**
Pharmacist tool to instantly generate personalised, print-ready patient instruction sheets for prescribed dermatology topical creams — bilingual, fully offline.
Built by: Pn Hanim (Farmasi · Paediatric Dermatology)
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/skin-diary

### Management Productivity

**ED Patient Acuity Dashboard**
Real-time Emergency Department dashboard displaying live patient acuity, triage categories, and bed status — giving clinical leads instant situational awareness.
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/ed-dashboard

**DLP Delivery Performance Dashboard**
Analytics dashboard tracking delivery performance metrics for the hospital's logistics and pharmacy distribution.
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/dlp-dashboard

**Roster Scheduling Web App**
Web-based tool that instantly generates oncall and duty rosters for medical and support staff — eliminating manual scheduling conflicts. Free to use.
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/roster-generator

**CGR Web Form**
Digital form for Clinical Governance and Risk reporting — replacing paper-based submissions.
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/cgr-form

**DLP Web Form**
Digital form for DLP (Delivery Performance) data entry.
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/dlp-form

**JPPOBG Portal Aktiviti**
Activity portal for the O&G department's JPPOBG committee — built by Dr Anita Rina bt Ali.
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/portal-aktiviti

**Incident Reporting Form**
Digital incident reporting web application replacing paper forms for hospital safety incident logging.
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/incident-form

**Slide Deck OCR PDF Editor**
Web-based AI editor that uses Gemini OCR to read and unlock text inside NotebookLM AI-generated slide deck PDFs — allowing edits directly in the browser. Free to use.
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/pdf-editor

**Sistem E-Kehadiran Kursus — Digital Training Log**
A centralized, paperless attendance registration and analytics portal for hospital staff training — replacing fragmented manual logs with instant IC validation, automatic age calculation, and a role-based administrative tracking dashboard. Features QR code-based registration, bilingual interface, and one-click CSV export for KKM compliance audits.
Built by: Unit Pengurusan & JPPOBG, Jabatan Pentadbiran HTPN
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/e-kehadiran

**PhysioMeasurePro — Automated Outcome Measure Engine**
An advanced clinical calculator and KKM-compliant reporting engine for physical therapists at HTPN. Covers 3 domains: Neurological (BBS, SCIM, MoCA, NIH Stroke Scale, Tinetti), Musculoskeletal (ODI, NDI, PSFS, FABQ, NPRS), and Cardiopulmonary (6MWT, 2MWT, Borg, mMRC, ISWT, ICU Mobility Scale). Instant automated risk categorization, auto-generated clinical problem lists, and suggested treatment plans. One-click KKM-compliant print-ready PDF. Receiving outstanding user feedback from physiotherapists.
Built by: Hospital Aman Sarawak
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/physio-measure-pro

**Hospital Marudi Phlebotomy Appointment System — Blood Sampling Engine**
A highly scalable pre-consultation phlebotomy booking platform for manual hospital ecosystems. Ward and outpatient staff pre-schedule blood draws before specialist appointments, eliminating "result not ready" consultations. Features specimen type routing (FBC, FBS, RP, LFT, FLP, UFEME), patient and staff audit modules, and an admin portal for daily workload monitoring. Scalable SaaS architecture deployable across multiple peripheral hospitals.
Built by: Hospital Marudi & HTPN AI Knowledge-Sharing Network
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/phlebotomy-booking

**MOH HIRARC Portal — Digital Occupational Safety & Health Ledger**
A cloud-based workplace risk assessment engine aligned with OSH Act 1994 and DOSH 2008 guidelines. Replaces static Excel HIRARC logs with a 3-step compliance pipeline: Basic Information Intake, Hazard Identification with automated Likelihood × Severity risk scoring (color-coded Low/Medium/High thresholds), and Executive Summary with auto-calculated 12-month review dates. Features live dashboard alerts for HIGH-risk hazards, one-click CSV and print-ready PDF export for DOSH inspections.
Built by: Unit Keselamatan & Kesihatan Pekerjaan (UKKP) Hospital Umum Sarawak
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/hirarc-portal

**MEDEVAC E-Request Portal — Airborne Emergency Logistics Engine**
A centralized medical evacuation submission portal for JKN Sarawak. Digitizes emergency air transfer coordination across Sarawak's vast geography — from remote district clinics to major tertiary centers. Three-hub architecture: Logistics (hospital routing, multi-agency authorization), Clinical (patient triage check-grid, diagnosis, transfer justification), and Weight Engine (dynamic escort manifest with real-time weight tracking). Generates instant locked PDF flight manifests. Prevents aircraft weight overruns and cuts flight activation lag.
Built by: Jabatan Kesihatan Negeri Sarawak (JKNS) & HTPN AI Knowledge-Sharing Network
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/medevac-portal

**MedMove Pro — Interfacility Patient Transport Engine**
A centralized, multi-role dispatch and fleet management system for patient transport. Replaces manual phone-based coordination with instant transport booking, automated driver assignment, and live performance analytics. Four role-based portals: Staff (booking), Dispatcher (queue & fleet), Driver (mobile), Manager (analytics). Tracks fleet utilization, completion rates, and provides immutable audit logs.
Built by: Jabatan Kesihatan Negeri Sarawak
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/medmove-pro

**Mental Wellbeing Monitoring Portal — Departmental Morale Tracker**
A high-frequency, 100% anonymous mental wellness pulse tool for the Occupational Safety and Health Unit (UKKP) HTPN — replacing once-a-year screenings with monthly departmental morale tracking to catch clinical burnout early. Uses Whooley Depression Screening and Anxiety Scale. Captures only non-identifying metadata (unit, job title, age). Aggregate analytics only — no individual identity tracking.
Built by: Unit Keselamatan dan Kesihatan Pekerjaan (UKKP) HTPN
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/projects/mental-wellbeing

---

## Pipeline Projects (In Development)

**AMR — Autonomous Mobile Robot**
Proof of Concept for deploying an autonomous mobile robot at Hospital Kajang to transport laboratory specimens from the Emergency Department to the Pathology Lab — cutting turnaround time and minimising human exposure risk. Partnership with Delta Global Automation.
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/pipeline/amr

**Drone Specimen Transfer**
Drone-based transfer of specimens and medications between the Main Building and the Women & Child Centre — autonomous logistics across the HTPN campus.
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/pipeline/drone-specimen

**Prison Virtual Clinic**
Secure specialist teleconsultation platform enabling HTPN doctors to conduct virtual clinics with prisoners at Kajang Prison via the Roketz platform.
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/pipeline/prison-virtual-clinic

**Facial AI — Vital Signs & HbA1c Scan**
A 35–50 second smartphone face scan that reads vital signs using facial photoplethysmography — no needles, no reagents. Clinically validated at HTPN's Emergency Department across a 400-patient, 3-phase study.
URL: https://htpn-showcase-v2.vercel.app/pipeline/facial-scan-ai

---

## About the HIO Team
The Healthcare Intelligence Office (HIO) at HTPN Kajang is led by clinicians who build, test, and deploy digital tools within their own wards and departments. The team operates on a principle of radical practicality: if it solves a real problem faced by staff or patients today, it gets built.

Hospital: Hospital Tengku Permaisuri Norashikin (HTPN)
Location: Kajang, Selangor, Malaysia
Ministry: Ministry of Health Malaysia (KKM / MOH)
Contact: udppkhtpn@moh.gov.my
